name: Ori
source:
There is a mysterious game store. Even though it's only games that are sold there, those feel so real...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-august-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]

有一家神秘的游戏店。店里明明只出售游戏，玩起来却真实得令人难以置信……
